Holam before vav

The first two groups show all 17 occurrences in 16 verses of MAM where a non-vav letter has a holam dot and the next letter is vav; combining marks may intervene. These groups exclude the divine name, including prefixed occurrences.

The third group, "Holam haser for vav before vav", requires vav with HOLAM HASER FOR VAV (U+05BA), followed by another vav as the next base letter. Combining marks may intervene; another letter may not. There are no occurrences in MAM.

In the first two groups, the blue text marks the holam-bearing letter and following vav. In the third group, it marks both vav letters. The original marks remain on their original letters. Each occurrence is enlarged and shown in adjacent columns; only the letter spacing differs.

In "With an above-mark on vav": zaqef qatan: 3; revia: 1.
